newsitem.title: THAILAND: TAC's five bln baht debentures rated "A" by TRIS.
newsitem.headline: TAC's five bln baht debentures rated "A" by TRIS.

text.p: Thai Rating and Information Service (TRIS) gave an "A" rating on Thursday to Total Access Communication Plc (TAC)'s five billion baht senior debentures.
TRIS said the rating reflected TAC's strong market positioning, management and generated cash flows, though they were partly offset by its high debt load and technological and regulatory risks.
It said TAC, the second largest and fastest growing Thai cellular phone operator, has the same credit quality of its parent, United Communication Plc, whose senior debt is also rated "A" by TRIS.
The credit rating agency projected that the number of TAC phone subscribers will rise by 50 percent in 1996 with growth seen gradually easing to 15-20 percent by the year 2000.
It said TAC's operating income margin was expected to remain near its current healthy level of about 50 percent.
It said TAC's rapid system expansion during 1994-1996 resulted in high debt burden growth to over seven billion baht in 1995.
TRIS said TAC's 9.5 billion baht initial public offering in 1995 sharply improved its financial position with its total debt-to-capitalisation ratio falling to 31 percent from 60 percent.
